frozen_with.mandacaru_reader: mandacaru.pseudopotentials.io._read_parquet(path, 'fastparquet') for the corpus; pyarrow.parquet for the cross-check

how_to_read_this_file.corpus: 431 shipped pseudopotential files: 'paw/<set>/<Symbol>.parquet' is <MANDACARU_PAW_PATH>/<set>/<Symbol>.parquet (lda-sr, lda-fr, pbe-sr, pbe-fr: 92 elements each = 368) and 'upaw/lda-sr/<Symbol>.parquet' is the UPAW-LCAO library (63). Each file has one row group and one data chunk per column; every chunk is ZSTD, PLAIN, DOUBLE, null_count 0.
how_to_read_this_file.corpus.files[*].columns: [column name, row count, SHA-256 of the column's float64 values as 8 little-endian bytes per value, file order]. The digest was computed independently from the fastparquet-based reader (through lists of Python floats) and from pyarrow (raw buffers); they agree on all columns, and the order of columns agrees.
how_to_read_this_file.corpus.files[*].kv: The single Mandacaru key-value entry 'mandacaru.pseudopotential' (a JSON text). The 133 MB of JSON text is NOT stored (it would not fit in the repository): 'bytes' and 'sha256' are over the exact UTF-8 bytes of the string in the footer; 'canonical_sha256' is over json.dumps(json.loads(text), sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8, which survives a reformatting of the same JSON.
how_to_read_this_file.corpus.files[*].kv_other_keys: Other footer key-value entries (the 'pandas' key that fastparquet adds), with byte length and SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes.
how_to_read_this_file.fixtures: Files under this folder (path relative to it). 'expect_new_reader' is 'ok' (a conforming reader decodes it) or 'error' (it must raise, never return data; 'new_reader_error_hint' lists substrings the message should mention, informative not binding). 'structure', 'kv' and 'decoded_by_pyarrow' are what pyarrow 26.0.0 reports; 'decoded_by_pyarrow' columns carry SHA-256 of the float64 bytes (nulls read as NaN) or of the UTF-8 values joined by NUL. KV values longer than 600 characters are replaced by {bytes, sha256}. 'pages_per_chunk' is [row group][column] and 'page_summary' lists 'PAGE_TYPE:encoding' for every page (counting dictionary pages), measured by scanning the page headers.
how_to_read_this_file.old_api_results.json: What the old Python code did on every fixture, per engine ('fastparquet', 'pyarrow'): load_hamiltonian, read_hamiltonian_header, load_pseudopotential, and the raw (columns, metadata) pair the old readers handed to the loaders. Doubles are float.hex strings. Exceptions are recorded by type, module and message with the fixture folder written as <FIXTURES>. Third-party DeprecationWarnings are dropped; warnings raised by Mandacaru are kept.
